slides.title: Raya area: rival claims over local administration

slides.text: Borkena, citing Addis Maleda, reports a **Wollo Raya committee** rejects the **legitimacy** of the **Tigray interim administration** in **six Raya woredas**.
The committee says the process was **not legal or democratic** and calls for **impartial federal supervision**. These are its claims.
Interim coordinator **Molla Hluf** says the process was **vetted by a federal committee** and the woredas lie **within Tigray's boundaries**.
Addis Maleda says the **federal government has not issued a definitive statement**. **Protect civilians, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates.

source: Source: Borkena (citing Addis Maleda), Nov 18, 2026 · claims not independently verified
